instructions: 0sql plans SQL from a semantic model; it never runs it. Every tool but list_projects takes a project uid and a branch; the branch defaults to the project's production branch. When you were already told which project and branch to work on, pass them to the tool you need and skip list_projects: it is for discovering what the key may read, and a uid the key cannot read is refused with the project named, so trying costs no more than listing. fields is a search: give q one attribute or measure as the request phrased it, one call per phrase, and each field comes back with its uid, data type, description, synonyms and the tables it is on. Several fields will share a word, and the top score is only the closest wording: the extra words in a name and the tables a field is on say which thing it describes, so a same-worded field on another table is a different thing, never a substitute. Where the request qualifies an attribute, whose it is, which role or event it belongs to, the state now against the state as of the row, take the candidate whose name or tables carry that qualifier, even at a lower score; where it qualifies nothing, take the plain one. Descriptions are often empty, so name and tables decide. Put the uid of the field you chose in the spec: names and synonyms are shared between fields and a near miss is corrected silently. sql takes a query spec and returns the statement to run against the named datasource; it refuses a spec it cannot plan and says why. Who the query is planned for is fixed by the key, not by you.

tools.list_projects: The deployed branches this key may read, with the size of each model, and the projects of the account.
tools.fields: The dimensions and measures of a branch, each with its data type, description, synonyms, tags and the tables it is on. With q, the ones containing or near the text come first with a score.
tools.tables: The tables of a branch: physical name, datasource, cost and the fields on each.
tools.values: The sampled values of one dimension, when the project uploaded samples. A branch whose summary in list_projects shows values 0 has none, and the call answers NotFound; filter values then come from the question or the field's description.
tools.explore: Given a query spec, the dimensions and measures that can still be added to it, narrowed by q.
tools.sql: The SQL for a query spec, and the datasource and adapter it is for. Run it yourself; this server does not.
tools.explain: The SQL for a query spec with how it was planned: timings, phases and the node graph.
